# About Jumbo Nextjs {#about-jumbo-nextjs .text-2xl .@xs:text-3xl .@lg:text-4xl .leading-tight .font-bold .flex .items-center .gap-[.5em] .grow .text-pretty .clear-right .xs:clear-none}

Jumbo 7.x \| Nextjs 15.x \| App Router \| MUI
::::

::::::::: {.flex .flex-col .[&>*+*]:mt-5 .whitespace-pre-wrap}
Jumbo 7.x version offers a complete dedicated Nextjs solution powered
with Jumbo Components to offer a better layout system, better theming
system using MUI as the base and hundreds of highly reusable components
to boost-up your project development speed. This saves your hundreds of
hours to setup the architectural things so that you can focus on your
idea or your features implementation only.
